remarks:
Welcome home to this charming village ranch located in the heart of Arcade! Enjoy the convenience of a walkable neighborhood with shops, restaurants, the village park, and school just a short stroll away. This well-maintained, all-electric home benefits from affordable power through Arcade Electric, helping to keep utility costs manageable.

Inside, you'll find a spacious updated kitchen with plenty of cabinetry and workspace, along with an updated bathroom that blends style and functionality. The flexible floor plan features a large family room that was formerly the third bedroom, offering additional living space and direct access through sliding glass doors to the rear deck.

Step outside and relax while overlooking the quiet, peaceful backyard, a perfect setting for morning coffee, entertaining, or simply enjoying the outdoors. An attached garage provides everyday convenience and easy access during all seasons.

Whether you're starting out, downsizing, or looking for low-maintenance village living, this home offers comfort, convenience, and small-town charm all in one package.
